Episode Notes:
In "The Importance of the Invasion of Sicily" — part of our Battle Studies series — Steven Barry identified important lessons from this World War II battle that still apply to warfare today. Kerry talks with Steven about what went right for the Allies in the operation and what went wrong. They also discuss the classic challenge of managing big egos.
